greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, uthando lukaThixo uYise, kunye nomanyano loMoya oyiNgcwele kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: INkosi inobubele nenceba, iyacotha ukunqumka kwaye inobubele obukhulu.
homily:
Khumbula umfanekiso onokuthi uwubone ngamehlo engqondo: uBenjamin Vo, esemncane, ehlezi ecaleni kukayise, bejongene nekhompyutha yakhe, bechaza indlela inkqubo entsha anokuyila ngayo. Ben wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhlela, ukwakha, nokubona indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo. Wayenomdla wokwenza izinto ezintsha, ezo 'Con Chim Airlines' zakhe ezaziphaphatheka ezingqondweni zakhe eziqaqambileyo. Kodwa ngaphezu kwayo yonke loo ntlakanipho, into eyayimenza uBen abe nguBen yayikukuthamba kwentliziyo yakhe. Khumbula umzuzu apho uBen, eseyinkwenkwana nje, wathi kubazali bakhe ufuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayaphule leyo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule, kodwa into ebalulekileyo kukuba wayenikile. Wayenikele ngayo yonke into awayenayo. Le yimveliso yentliziyo enothando olumsulwa, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukuzidela ngaphandle kokungabaza.

Namhlanje, iLizwi likaThixo lisimemela kwinto enzima kakhulu: ukuxolela. UPetros ubuza uYesu, 'Nkosi, ukuba umntu undonile, ndimele ndimxolele kangaphi?' Kwaye uYesu uphendula ngesibalo esingapheliyo. Kodwa masithathe eli xesha simise kancane. UYesu ubalisa ngomkhonzi owayenetyala elikhulu, elingenakuhlawulwa. Inkosi yathi mayixolelwe yonke loo nto. Kodwa lo mkhonzi, xa ephuma, wabamba umhlobo wakhe owawumtyala imali encinci, wamkrola intamo, wamfaka entolongweni. Le yinyani ebuhlungu. Nathi maxa wambi, siphila ngolu hlobo. Sifumana inceba kaThixo, kodwa sibambelele kwinzondo okanye kumsindo kwabanye. USirach usixelela ngokucacileyo: 'Ngaba umntu onenyama angagcina inzondo, aze alindele ukuphiliswa yiNkosi?'

Bafowethu nodadewethu, masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. UBen wayekuthanda kakhulu. Wayekuthanda njengoba wayekuthanda ukulalela amabali kaBawo. Wayekuthanda njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan, kwi-roller coaster. Uthando lwakhe lwaluphelele.

Kukho inkolelo yokuba kufuneka sibe netyala ngokuthile ukuze sibe nentlungu. Kodwa uYesu, xa ebona indoda eyayizalwe iyimfama, wathi akukho mntu wonayo, akukho mntu wenza impazamo. Ubomi buhamba ngeendlela esingazaziyo. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayakha isiseko sayo edwaleni. Ukholo lwakhe, ububele bakhe, uthando lwakhe—konke oku kwakuyisiseko esomeleleyo. Xa isiphango sezifo size, loo ndlu ayizange iwe, kuba yayakhiwe kakuhle. UBen usekhululekile ngoku. Akasabandezeleki. Usebanquet yasezulwini, ecaleni kukaSaint Carlo Acutis, owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengalo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.'

Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndilangazelela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngokomoya. Njengokuba sele ukhona, ndiyakwamkela ndize ndizidibanise nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isilondoloze, kwaye isikhanyisele ngobuso bayo. Hamba noxolo lweNkosi.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele anikele ithemba ezintliziyweni zabo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Umsindo nenzondo zizinto ezilihlazo, kodwa isoni sizigcina ngokuqinileyo. Lowo uziphindezelayo uya kufumana impindezelo yeNkosi, kuba iyakukhumbula izono zakhe ngokweenkcukacha. Xolela ummelwane wakho ngenxa yokungabikho kwesisa; ngoko xa uthandaza, izono zakho ziya kuxolelwa. Ngaba umntu angagcina inzondo ngomnye aze alindele ukuphiliswa yiNkosi? Ngaba umntu angala inceba komnye onjengaye, aze afune uxolelo lwezono zakhe? Ukuba umntu onenyama ugcina umsindo, ngubani oya kuxolela izono zakhe? Khumbula imihla yakho yokugqibela, ubeke bucala ubutshaba; khumbula ukufa nokubola, kwaye uyeke ukona! Khumbula imithetho, musa ukumthiya ummelwane wakho; khumbula umnqophiso woPhezukonke, kwaye ungawuhoyi amaphoso.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Akukho mntu kuthi uphilela yena, kwaye akukho mntu ufela yena. Kuba ukuba siphila, siphilela iNkosi, kwaye ukuba siyafa, sifela iNkosi; ngoko ke, nokuba siphila nokuba siyafa, singabakwaNkosi. Kuba kungenxa yoko uKristu wafayo wavuka, ukuze abe yiNkosi yabafileyo neyabaphilayo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UPetros wasondela kuYesu wambuza, 'Nkosi, ukuba umzalwana wam undonile, ndimele ndimxolele kangaphi? Amaxesha asixhenxe?' UYesu waphendula wathi, 'Ndithi kuwe, hayi amaxesha asixhenxe, kodwa amaxesha angamashumi asixhenxe anesixhenxe.' Kungenxa yoko ubukumkani bamazulu bunokufaniswa nokumkani owagqiba ekubeni alungise iincwadi nabakhonzi bakhe. Xa waqalayo ukubala, kwaziswa umkhonzi owayemtyala imali eninzi. Ngenxa yokuba wayengenandlela yakuyihlawula, inkosi yakhe yayalela ukuba athengiswe, kunye nomfazi wakhe, abantwana bakhe, nazo zonke iimpahla zakhe, ukuhlawula ityala. Ngoko ke, umkhonzi wawa phantsi, wamkhahlela wathi, 'Yiba nomonde kum, ndiya kukuhlawula yonke into.' Enovelwano, inkosi yaloo mkhonzi yamkhulula yamxolela netyala. Xa loo mkhonzi ephumile, wafumana omnye wabakhonzi abangamaqabane akhe owayemtyala imali encinane. Wamphatha ngamandla wamkrola intamo, esithi, 'Hlawula oko ukutyalayo.' Wawa ngamadolo, umkhonzi wakhe wambongoza wathi, 'Yiba nomonde kum, ndiya kukuhlawula.' Kodwa wala. Kunoko, wamfaka entolongweni umkhonzi wakhe de ahlawule ityala. Ngoko ke, xa abanye abakhonzi babonayo okwenzekileyo, bakhathazeka kakhulu, baya kunkosi yabo bayixelela yonke loo nto. Inkosi yakhe yamema yathi kuye, 'Mkhonzi mubi! Ndikuxolele lonke ityala lakho kuba ubundibongoza. Ngaba ubungamele ube nenceba kumkhonzi wakho, njengoko ndibe nenceba kuwe?' Ngoko ke, ngomsindo, inkosi yamnikela kwizicwangciso zokungcungcuthekisa de ahlawule lonke ityala. Ngaloo ndlela uYise wasemazulwini uya kwenza kuni, ngaphandle kokuba ngamnye wenu axolele umzalwana wakhe ukusuka entliziyweni yakhe.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school
